course_name_original: Principios de máquinas y circuitos eléctricos
course_name_en: Principles of Electrical Machines and Circuits

learning_outcomes.text: Apply the principles of circuit theory and electrical machines in the resolution of electrical circuits
Recognize and understand the principles of circuit theory and electrical machines applied in the resolution of electrical circuits
Recognize and understand the training needs that will be useful to successfully resolve new situations related to industrial engineering.
Act effectively in a multilingual and multidisciplinary team
Ability to perform laboratory assemblies and experiments
Design in the field of industrial technical engineering
Develop projects in the field of industrial technical engineering
Propose creative solutions to satisfactorily respond to real needs and problems of society
Develop professional texts and scientific-technical reports according to the conventions of the field of industrial technical engineering
Adapt the organization of content and the use of language, verbal and non-verbal, to argue in various situations or before various audiences
Recognize and understand the necessary legislation for the exercise of the profession of industrial technical engineer
Apply the knowledge of industrial engineering in learning new methods and theories
Show the advantages and opportunities of different solutions to the same problem in a critical and constructive way
Apply the appropriate legislation to the exercise of the profession of industrial technical engineer

syllabus_topics: Topic 1: BASIC CONCEPTS: CIRCUIT ELEMENTS, ENERGY, AND POWER. Active and passive elements and their behavior equations. Calculation of power and energy involved by these elements
Topic 2: CIRCUIT ANALYSIS METHODS AND THEOREMS. Kirchhoff's Laws, Thévenin/Norton theorems, and the superposition principle. Mesh and node methods.
BLOCK II: CIRCUITS IN SINUSOIDAL STEADY STATE
Topic 1: CIRCUITS IN SINUSOIDAL STEADY STATE. Application of concepts from the previous block to sinusoidal alternating current circuits.
Topic 1: SIMPLE TRANSIENT CIRCUITS. Resolution of first-order circuits in transient state.
BLOCK IV: INTRODUCTION TO ELECTRICAL MACHINES
Topic 1: MAGNETIC CIRCUITS AND ELECTROMECHANICAL ENERGY CONVERTERS. Review of electromagnetism applied to electrical machines.
Topic 2: COMMON GENERAL ASPECTS OF ELECTRICAL MACHINES. Basic operating principles of electrical machines.
Topic 3: CLASSIFICATION, CHARACTERISTICS AND MAIN APPLICATIONS OF ELECTRICAL MACHINES. Discussion and classification of different types of electrical machines and an overview of their applications.
assessment_rules: To pass the subject, it is OBLIGATORY to obtain a final grade of 5.0 out of 10.0 in the Assignments component. No average will be calculated with the rest of the tests if this condition is not met. Similarly, to pass, it is OBLIGATORY to obtain a final grade of 5.0 out of 10.0 in the Mixed tests component. No average will be calculated with the rest of the tests if this condition is not met. The 'Other forms of evaluation' component involves the submission and/or presentation of problems proposed by the professor.
